description: §47.1.1 (S439 #7) — a state cell, a function and a parameter declared with the reserved `_scrml_` prefix, then referenced. Each declaration and each reference is E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED-PREFIX. (-pos: the code fires.)
rationale: §47.1.1 S439 ruling (#7): a user-authored scrml program SHALL NOT declare a binding whose name begins with `_scrml_`; that prefix names compiler/runtime identifiers. Such a declaration is a compile error, E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED-PREFIX.
